title: Length of Service and the Projected Daily Water Use for a Final-Statement Prepayment — Utility Pass-Through Service
content:
**Rule.** For a prepayment of the estimated final Utility Pass-Through Service statement, the length of service decides the projected daily use. For an account whose service began twelve or more whole months before the handling date, the projected daily use for a final-statement prepayment is the average consumption of the actual water reads taken in the last twelve months divided by 30; for an account whose service began fewer than four whole months before the handling date, it is the consumption of the latest actual water read divided by 30. On any other account the four-month average divided by 30 is not replaced.

**Counting.** Service began on the account's service start date; whole months are counted from that date to the handling date. An actual water read is taken in the last twelve months when fewer than 12 whole months separate its read date from the handling date. The latest actual water read is the actual water read with the latest read date.

## Decision table

| Whole months from service start to the handling date | Projected daily use |
|---|---|
| 0 to 3 (fewer than 4) | Consumption of the latest actual water read, divided by 30 |
| 4 to 11 | Not replaced (four-month average divided by 30) |
| 12 or more | Average of the actual water reads of the last 12 months, divided by 30 |

## Boundaries (handling date 10 June, hypothetical)

| Service start date | Whole months | Row |
|---|---|---|
| 11 February | 3 | Latest actual read |
| 10 February | 4 | Not replaced |
| 11 June of the previous year | 11 | Not replaced |
| 10 June of the previous year | 12 | Twelve-month average |

**Worked figures (hypothetical).** An account in service for 30 months whose actual water reads of the last 12 months total 51.60 kgal over 12 reads: average 4.30 kgal, divided by 30, gives about 0.1433 kgal a day. An account in service for 2 months whose latest actual water read is 3.60 kgal: 3.60 divided by 30 is 0.12 kgal a day.
